title: Herbal American Stir Fry
description: A delicious and colorful stir fry dish combining the flavors of American cuisine with the freshness of herbs. Perfect for a quick and easy dinner.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it starts to soften, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the chopped bell pepper and sliced carrots, and cook for another 4-5 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Add the sliced American stir and cook for 1-2 minutes, or until it starts to brown.
Add the chopped herbal mix and stir well to combine.
Pour in the soy sauce and stir to coat the ingredients.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
